summary: +1 to attack and damage rolls; a creature it hits may blurt out its name, and once a day its name turns a hit into a Critical Hit.
text: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this dagger. When you hit a creature that knows a language with it, the creature makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or speaks its true name aloud; on a success it can't be affected this way again for 24 hours. Once per dawn, after a creature has spoken its name to the needle, you can speak that name (no action) so that your next hit against it with the needle is a Critical Hit.

powers.name: Speak Its Name
powers.text: Speak a name the needle has heard: your next hit with it against that creature is a Critical Hit.
